faculty.name: Melissa Tully
faculty.summary: Studies news literacy, misinformation and engagement in global media, with a focus on African media, including current work on misinformation in Kenya.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究全球媒介中的新闻素养、虚假信息与参与，重点关注非洲媒介，目前开展肯尼亚虚假信息与新闻素养研究。

faculty.name: Venise Berry
faculty.summary: Develops African American cultural criticism and a theory of "racialism" on media images of African Americans in youth media, popular culture and film.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事非裔美国人文化批评，发展“种族主义化”（racialism）理论，研究青少年媒介、流行文化与电影中的非裔美国人形象。

faculty.name: David Dowling
faculty.summary: Studies narrative, podcast and immersive longform journalism and how digital publishing industries shape multimedia storytelling, from 360/VR to gamified news.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究叙事新闻、播客新闻与沉浸式长篇报道，以及数字出版产业如何塑造从360度/VR到游戏化新闻的多媒体叙事。

faculty.name: Meenakshi Gigi Durham
faculty.summary: Examines media and the politics of the body, focusing on gender, sexuality, race, youth cultures and sexual violence from a feminist perspective.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介与身体政治，聚焦性别、性向、种族、青少年文化与性暴力等议题，具有女性主义视角。

faculty.name: Brian Ekdale
faculty.summary: Studies algorithmic personalization, digital media production and disparities in scholarly knowledge production, including algorithmic imaginaries and election information disorder.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究算法个性化、数字媒介生产与学术知识生产中的不平等，包括社交媒体用户的算法想象与选举中的信息失序。

faculty.name: Brett Johnson
faculty.summary: Studies media law, media ethics and media sociology and how digital technology disrupts them, including hate speech coverage, public records and civility rules.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介法、媒介伦理与媒介社会学及数字技术对其的冲击，涉及仇恨言论报道、公共记录与公共会议文明规范等。

faculty.name: Sang Jung Kim
faculty.summary: Studies how technology, politics and social identity interact on social media, analyzing multimodal messages with experiments and computational methods such as visual framing at scale.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社交媒体上技术、政治与社会身份的互动，运用实验和计算方法分析多模态信息，如大规模视觉框架分析。

faculty.name: Jamil Marques
faculty.summary: Studies political communication, journalism and public opinion from a global and comparative perspective, with a focus on Latin America, Brazil and de-Westernizing knowledge production.
faculty.summary_zh: 从全球与比较视角研究政治传播、新闻业与舆论，聚焦拉丁美洲与巴西，并关注知识生产的去西方化。

faculty.name: Thomas Oates
faculty.summary: Studies how sport media make athletes and games meaningful, critically analyzing sports coverage in magazines, newspapers, websites, video games and video.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究体育媒介如何赋予运动员与赛事意义，以批判文化视角分析杂志、报纸、网站、电子游戏和视频中的体育报道。

faculty.name: Alex Scott
faculty.summary: Studies the political, economic and aesthetic forces in photojournalism and how non-fiction visual practices construct social difference, with work on visual theory and migration.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究影响新闻摄影实践的政治、经济与美学力量，分析非虚构视觉实践如何建构社会差异，并涉及视觉理论与移民议题。

faculty.name: Sujatha Sosale
faculty.summary: Studies media and social change in the Global South, including news on development, the political economy of colonial media technologies, and mobile media use in rural South India.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究全球南方的媒介与社会变迁，包括发展议题新闻、殖民语境中媒介技术的政治经济学以及南印度农村的移动媒介使用。

faculty.name: Travis Vogan
faculty.summary: Studies sport, media and U.S. culture, writing critical and industrial histories of sports film, television and documentary such as ESPN, NFL Films and ABC Sports.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究体育、媒介与美国文化，撰写体育电影、电视与纪录片的批判性与产业史研究，如ESPN、NFL Films和ABC Sports。

faculty.name: Rachel Young
faculty.summary: Studies media effects on health, health journalism and stigma using mixed methods: textual and content analysis, interviews, a national survey and experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介对健康的影响、健康新闻与污名，采用混合方法，包括文本与内容分析、访谈、全国调查和实验。

faculty.name: Bingbing Zhang
faculty.summary: Studies how people process (mis)information on health, science and politics and the effects of strategic messages and AI content, using surveys, experiments and content analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何处理有关健康、科学与政治的（虚假）信息，以及策略性信息和AI生成内容的效果，主要采用调查、实验与内容分析。

faculty.name: Kembrew McLeod
faculty.summary: Studies popular music, independent media and copyright law, producing books and documentary films on intellectual property and freedom of expression.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究流行音乐、独立媒体与版权法，以著作和纪录片探讨知识产权与表达自由。

faculty.name: Logan Brown
faculty.summary: Writes critical histories of games and entertainment software, tracing how the early American mobile games industry shaped platform economics and digital labor.
faculty.summary_zh: 以批判视角书写游戏与娱乐软件的历史，追溯早期美国手机游戏产业如何塑造平台经济与数字劳动。

faculty.name: Shelly Campo
faculty.summary: Designs and evaluates theory-based health campaigns and studies risk communication and persuasion for audiences such as college students and rural and minority populations.
faculty.summary_zh: 设计并评估基于理论的健康传播运动，研究面向大学生、农村和少数族裔人群的风险传播与说服。

faculty.name: Emerson Cram
faculty.summary: Studies critical environmental justice, linking race, disability, sexuality and environment, through queer ecology and archives, interviews and fieldwork in the US West and Iowa.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究批判性环境正义，探讨种族、残障、性向与环境的关系，以酷儿生态学视角结合档案、访谈与田野调查研究美国西部与爱荷华。

faculty.name: Steve Duck
faculty.summary: Studies personal relationships and how they are rhetorically presented in everyday life.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个人关系及其在日常生活中如何被修辞性地呈现。

faculty.name: Natalie Fixmer-Oraiz
faculty.summary: Studies rhetoric and reproductive justice, including US security culture, commercial surrogacy, queer kinship and care, and feminist movements.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究修辞与生育正义，涉及美国安全文化、商业代孕、酷儿亲属关系与照护以及女性主义运动。

faculty.name: Ashley Hall
faculty.summary: Studies Black American rhetorical cultures and Black women's public discourse, ratchetness and worldmaking, including figures such as Cardi B and Megan Thee Stallion.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究美国黑人修辞文化与黑人女性的公共话语、“ratchetness”与世界建构，包括Cardi B和Megan Thee Stallion等人物。

faculty.name: Tim Havens
faculty.summary: Studies television, media industries and media globalization, including race and media, platform studies, and Hungarian television and film location industries.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究电视、媒介产业与媒介全球化，涉及种族与媒介、平台研究以及匈牙利电视与影视拍摄地产业。

faculty.name: Joy Elizabeth Hayes
faculty.summary: Studies media history and theory, including US and Mexican broadcasting history, race and ethnicity in media, community media, and the development of docudrama.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介史与理论，包括美国与墨西哥广播史、媒介中的种族与族裔、社区媒体以及纪实剧的发展。

faculty.name: Jiyeon Kang
faculty.summary: Studies how marginalized groups reshape dominant discourses through digital media, publics and counterpublics, including youth Internet activism in South Korea and intercultural coexistence.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究边缘群体如何借助数字媒介、公众与反公众重塑主导话语，包括韩国青年网络行动主义与跨文化共存。

faculty.name: Helen Lillie
faculty.summary: Studies health and interpersonal communication: how resilience is built with close others and how narratives and emotion persuade people toward healthy behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康与人际传播：如何通过与亲近者的沟通建立韧性，以及叙事与情绪如何说服人们采取健康行为。

faculty.name: Kate Magsamen-Conrad
faculty.summary: Studies health and interpersonal communication through community-engaged mixed-methods projects, including interventions and technology's role in health management.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过社区参与式混合方法项目研究健康与人际传播，包括干预项目以及技术在健康管理中的作用。

faculty.name: Rachel McLaren
faculty.summary: Studies interpersonal communication, social cognition and hurtful messages, examining how relational turbulence shapes how couples process relational messages.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人际传播、社会认知与伤害性信息，考察关系动荡如何影响伴侣对关系信息的处理。

faculty.name: Sylvia Mikucki-Enyart
faculty.summary: Studies interpersonal and family communication under relational uncertainty, including in-law relationships, late-life parental divorce and sexual communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究关系不确定情境下的人际与家庭传播，包括姻亲关系、晚年父母离婚以及性沟通。

faculty.name: Carol Severino
faculty.summary: Studies the relationships among writing, language background, culture and pedagogy, especially in writing centers and second-language writing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究写作、语言背景、文化与教学之间的关系，尤其关注写作中心与二语写作。

faculty.name: Jenna Supp-Montgomerie
faculty.summary: Studies relationships among water, infrastructure and religion, including the religious origins of network culture traced through the 1858 Atlantic Telegraph.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究水、基础设施与宗教之间的关系，包括通过1858年大西洋电报追溯网络文化的宗教起源。

faculty.name: Rita Zajacz
faculty.summary: Studies how states seek control over global communications infrastructure, including the history of radio network governance and online anonymity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究国家如何寻求对全球传播基础设施的控制，包括无线电网络治理的历史与网络匿名性。
